headline_seed: Nine people, including children, dead after mass shooting in Pennsylvania - The Guardian
draft_text:
#BreakingMews
Mass shooting near 7th & Perry St, Erie, PA. AP corrected its count to 8 dead, not including the shooter. ABC News reports 9. Erie Police Chief Rick Lorah called it among the hardest scenes in his 28-year career.

And that's the mews.
